subject: [PATCH 10/60] sched/numa: restrict NUMA migration targets to common memory

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series aims to restrict NUMA migration targets to common memory nodes, addressing a limitation in the current implementation where migrations to memoryless nodes can fail. The change involves updating the should_numa_migrate_memory() function to check for N_MEMORY_COMMON instead of N_MEMORY.
